title: Unique natural isomorphism from scalar-localized component formulas
statement: Let R and S be commutative rings, C an R-linear preadditive category and D an S-linear preadditive category, with t in R and v in S. Let ψ : Localization.Away t → Localization.Away v be any function. Given ordinary functors F₀,G₀ : C ⥤ D and e : F₀ ≅ G₀, let additive functors F,G between the two raw scalar localizations have objects equal to those of F₀,G₀ and maps on each a tensor f heterogeneously equal to ψ(a) tensor F₀(f), ψ(a) tensor G₀(f). Then there is a unique natural isomorphism F ≅ G whose hom component at each K is heterogeneously equal to localization applied to e.hom.app K.obj. No ring homomorphism assumption on ψ is needed: naturality only compares the same scalar in both functors.

proof.text: Prove naturality by induction on a localized Hom tensor. The zero and sum cases use additivity; for a pure tensor rewrite both functor maps using their specifications, apply the scalar-localization composition formula, and use ordinary naturality of e. Assemble with NatIso.ofComponents. Any second isomorphism with the same components agrees by Iso.ext and NatTrans.ext.

theorem existsUnique_iso_of_component_formulas
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C] [Linear R C]
    {D : Type*} [Category D] [Preadditive D] [Linear S D]
    (t : R) (v : S) (ψ : Localization.Away t → Localization.Away v)
    (F₀ G₀ : C ⥤ D) (e : F₀ ≅ G₀)
    (F G : ScalarLocalization R C t ⥤ ScalarLocalization S D v)
    [F.Additive] [G.Additive]
    (hF : ∀ K, F.obj K = ⟨F₀.obj K.obj⟩)
    (hG : ∀ K, G.obj K = ⟨G₀.obj K.obj⟩)
    (mF : ∀ (K K' : C) (f : K ⟶ K') (a : Localization.Away t),
      HEq (F.map (a ⊗ₜ[R] f : ScalarLocalization.mk (R := R) (p := t) K ⟶ ⟨K'⟩))
        (ψ a ⊗ₜ[S] F₀.map f : ScalarLocalization.mk (R := S) (p := v) (F₀.obj K) ⟶
          ⟨F₀.obj K'⟩))
    (mG : ∀ (K K' : C) (f : K ⟶ K') (a : Localization.Away t),
      HEq (G.map (a ⊗ₜ[R] f : ScalarLocalization.mk (R := R) (p := t) K ⟶ ⟨K'⟩))
        (ψ a ⊗ₜ[S] G₀.map f : ScalarLocalization.mk (R := S) (p := v) (G₀.obj K) ⟶
          ⟨G₀.obj K'⟩)) :
    ∃! a : F ≅ G, ∀ K, HEq (a.hom.app K)
      ((ScalarLocalization.localization S D v).map (e.hom.app K.obj))
